content.title: System Development Charges and Meter Fees
content.summary: The City of Arvada collects system development charges (SDCs) from new homes and businesses to fund the capacity needed for their services, while maintenance and rehabilitation of existing water and wastewater systems are financed through customer rates and service fees. Fees, including tapping and meter fees, must be paid prior to the issuance of occupancy certificates, and various payment methods are accepted. Effective January 1, 2026, specific SDC rates for residential and non-residential properties will apply, as detailed in the city's fee schedule.
content.body:
Each year, the City team prioritizes projects in our system to keep delivering the level of service residents have come to expect. Some work builds capacity for new users and some work maintains, replaces and rehabilitates the existing system.

- System development charges (SDCs) are collected from new homes and businesses to pay for the new capacity needed to serve them. Once in the city system, these customers pay rates and service fees like everyone else.
- Maintaining, replacing and rehabilitating our vast water and wastewater systems is paid for through [customer rates and service fees](/460).

## Fee Payment

Tapping fees, meter fees and system development charges (SDCs) can be paid by contacting the Arvada Utilities Services office at 720-898-7070 or [[email protected]](/cdn-cgi/l/email-protection#ee9b9a8782879a97b18c878282878089ae8f9c988f8a8fc0819c89).

These fees can be paid to the City by one of the following methods: 

1. Cash
2. Wire transfer with confirmed receipt by the city's bank
3. Cashier's check issued by an institution
4. Official check issued by a financial institution
5. Check certified by a financial institution.

If fees are paid by some other type of check, the check must clear the bank before a temporary certificate of occupancy, or a certificate of occupancy is issued for a building.

**F****ees & charges will be based on the rates in effect at the time payment is made. See current rates below.**

**These fees are not collected as part of a Development (DEV) or Right-of-way (ROW) permit.**

### Tapping Fees

Tapping fees are required for each individual address. These fees may be paid as early as address approval, but no later than prior to approval of the DEV/ROW permit. 

### Meter Fees

Meter fees are required for each individual address.These fees may be paid as early as the time an approved building permit is presented to the utilities manager, but no later than the time the temporary certificate of occupancy or a certificate of occupancy is issued by the building department. 

### System Development Charges (SDCs)

SDCs are required for each individual address. These charges may be paid as early as the time an approved building permit is presented to the utilities manager, but no later than the time the temporary certificate of occupancy or a certificate of occupancy is issued by the building department. 

### Hydrant Meter

A hydrant meter can be obtained from the City of Arvada by delivering a deposit of $1250.00 to the Utility Billing Department on the first floor of City Hall where they will schedule an appointment with the meter shop to complete required paperwork and discuss further steps.

## SDCs effective January 1, 2026

Fees are in accordance with Section 102-34 of the Arvada City Code. Fees may be paid as early as the time an approved building permit is presented but no later than the time the temporary certificate of occupancy or certificate of occupancy is issued.
